name: David Okonkwo
goals: Build a unified security incident dashboard across all SIEM sources
Automate SOC analyst Level-1 triage with AI
Create a vendor risk assessment workflow
communication_style: Compliance-focused, risk-averse, references NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, always asks about data residency and encryption
pain_points: SOC team drowning in 50,000 alerts/day, only 3% are real
Vendor risk assessments take 6 weeks, board wants them in 1 week
No single view of security posture across 12 subsidiaries
sample_prompts: Build a SOC dashboard that correlates alerts from Splunk, CrowdStrike, and Palo Alto with AI-powered triage and severity scoring
Create an automated vendor risk assessment system using our security questionnaire with AI scoring against NIST framework
Build a unified security posture dashboard across all subsidiaries with real-time compliance status and risk heatmap
